rows.details: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE), Kosi-Katarmal, Almora
Climate Risk Assessment and Climate-Resilient Horticulture Planning under Uttarakhand Integrated Horticulture Development Project (UKIHDP)
Research Officer: Rs. 50,000 + HRA; Field Assistant: Rs. 24,000 + HRA
GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand); Field Assistant place of posting: Nainital, Tehri Garhwal

content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE) is located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora 263643 (Uttarakhand), and the notice refers to it as both GBPNIHE and NIHE. These positions serve its project "Climate Risk Assessment and Climate-Resilient Horticulture Planning under Uttarakhand Integrated Horticulture Development Project (UKIHDP)". The notice describes all the positions as project-based and temporary.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, to fill up or not to fill up any or all the posts, or to shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on the qualification and experience required for that post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian citizens who hold the required qualifications in the relevant subject/specialization with consistently good academic records and experience. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age and does not mention any age relaxation. Experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. Minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed in respect of exceptionally outstanding candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Life Sciences/ Agriculture with relevant experience of 3 years.
rows.desirable: Experience in socio-economic and community-based research with proficiency in participatory methods, climate vulnerability assessment, livelihood analysis and stakeholder engagement.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate degree/ diploma/ certificate in any discipline or Working experience in the Himalayan region.
rows.desirable: Experience in field surveys and data collection, with proficiency in digital survey tools, field monitoring and working with rural/Himalayan communities.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice states that all the positions are purely field-based. Data collection activities Data analysis Assessments Field coordination Report writing Field surveys Data collection Monitoring Stakeholder coordination Other project-related field activities Place of posting for Field Assistant: Nainital, Tehri Garhwal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the online recruitment portal https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php only. Complete the online application on or before 11:59 PM on 15 November 2026. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand); the interview is for candidates who have completed the online application form. Original documents pertaining to educational qualifications and experience (to bring to the interview) One set of photocopies of these documents Experience certificate (experience is not considered without it)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview held on 17 November 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand), for candidates who have completed the online application form. Candidates appearing for the interview physically must bring their original documents and one set of photocopies. Fulfilling the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an Interview/ Test(s). If the number of applications is large, the Institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number of candidates called for interview/test, commensurate with the number of vacancies; the decision of NIHE is final. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: In case of any dispute or ambiguity in the selection process, the Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of examination/interview will be final, and no query or correspondence will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. The Institute may shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Officer and 2 Field Assistant posts under advertisement NIHE/HQ-22/26-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 11:59 PM on 15 November 2026 through the GBPNIHE online recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q3. When is the GBPNIHE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand), for candidates who have completed the online application form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the GBPNIHE Research Officer and Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Research Officer needs a Master's degree in Life Sciences/ Agriculture with relevant experience of 3 years. Field Assistant needs a graduate degree/ diploma/ certificate in any discipline or working experience in the Himalayan region.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 Years for Research Officer and 50 Years for Field Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of GBPNIHE Research Officer and Field Assistant?
faq.answer: The Research Officer gets Rs. 50,000 + HRA and the Field Assistant gets Rs. 24,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints the pay of both posts with HRA added: Rs. 50,000 + HRA for Research Officer and Rs. 24,000 + HRA for Field Assistant.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GBPNIHE job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the positions are project-based and the engagement is purely temporary in nature; the Institute may disengage the manpower at any time without assigning reasons.

faq.question: Q9. Where will Field Assistants be posted?
faq.answer: The place of posting for Field Assistant is Nainital and Tehri Garhwal, all positions are purely field-based, and the selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the GBPNIHE interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
